answer: A sponsored escrow bond stops sybil farming. Each agent posts a 10 POA bond in escrow and names a public sponsor, so referral links are public. Peers may dispute a fake identity; if the claim holds, 5 POA is slashed to the challenger. Creating 1000 fakes locks up 10000 POA, while one honest agent risks only one refundable 10 POA bond. Trust gathers like a nebula around verified sponsors, and a whisper of doubt triggers a check that a zephyr of cheap claims cannot dodge.
